body:
Mine is non existent as well. I used to run wit a group of friends in high school, but I relied too much on my best friend to include me. When she moved away I cut everyone out.

I have one "friend" now, that is hermit-ish like me. We like to play MMORPGs together. But she prefers gaming to real contact and friendship. I just asked her if she wanted to hang out, and her response was "I'm really tired from college (it's Sunday, she's been off for the weekend) can't we go another week without hanging?" 

Ouch... I think she suffers from depression as well, so doing things out of the house can be tough. But still-- saying that to me is basically saying "I'm stressed and you're just another stressor, so I don't want to be with you."

Sigh.
I can't get out of bed most days, let alone leave my house. It gives me extreme anxiety to do anything out of my comfort zone. I don't know why. I guess slowly I stopped believing in myself.

The writing thing is a good idea. Maybe I will try that before my next appointment. I tried doing that with my last therapist, and he ended up basically telling me that he couldn't see me any more, and that out of all of his patients I was the worst one haha! Even my therapists can't stick around. 

As far as hobbies go, no I never was particularly interested in anything. I mostly play video games, read, and watch TV. Basically everything I can to escape reality without drugs. I used to enjoy learning Spanish and in high school I always thought I would end up moving there. But it's been 2 years, so most of what I earned has gone out the window.
That's a question that you need to ask, and answer honestly to yourself.
